_comment: Display metadata for chains on MAINNET: the accent color the UI paints a
chain in (chart segments, chain labels). The testnet deployment reads
chainInfos.testnet.json; the file is picked by the app.isMainnet setting.
This file is the source of truth - recoloring a chain is an edit here, no
frontend rebuild and no redeploy. Edits are picked up on the next request
(the file is re-read whenever its mtime changes), so no restart either.
"chain" is the id the rest of the API uses (see enabledChains in /settings)
and is read lowercase. An entry for a chain this deployment does not serve
is simply unused, and a chain with no entry falls back to unknownChain -
and to the UI's own default accent when that is not set either.
Which chains exist and what the UI names them stays out of this file: it
only says what color they are.
